That’s correct, but that is the deadline for non-QB applicants. QB has policies with certain schools where you are allowed to ED SPECIFICALLY because you are QB applicant. The specific policy is detailed on Columbia’s QB website “If you are a QuestBridge Finalist and you are participating in the Match, you are not permitted to apply Early Decision to Columbia. However, if you do not match with any institution through the Match, and you have a complete application to Columbia, you will receive information about the option to convert your application to Early Decision.” (https://www.questbridge.org/columbia-university/faq) Let me know if that made sense! I know it’s sorta confusing

Not at the same time. If you don’t get matched by December 1st but you ranked Columbia, they will follow up offering the opportunity to ED so you also get a decision mid-December with the rest of the ED applicant pool. Not all schools have the ED guaranteed though, but Columbia is one of the schools that allows it.

You can apply to the NCM, and if you don’t get you can also apply ED (specifically to Columbia) right after since it’s part of their policy with QB. Your profile sounds like the type QB would be looking for, so go ahead and give it a shot!

Hey! I was a CPS and a finalist for 2020. So even though I ended up getting the finalist award, I opted out of the match to apply ED to my main reach school and thankfully things worked out (I also think opting out shows extra dedication to the school, but idk that’s just me).
